figurative_meaning_bn: বশে আনা; শায়েস্তা করা; সংশোধন করা
figurative_meaning_en: To bring under control; to subdue; to correct or discipline
similar_in_english: To knock some sense into someone
To put someone in their place
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই ছেলেটাকে ঢিট করতে হবে না, সে নিজেই শিখে যাবে।
বাবা বললেন, তোমাকে ঢিট করে শায়েস্তা করব যদি না পড়াশোনা করো।
example_sentences_in_english: This boy won't need to be disciplined harshly; he'll learn on his own.
Father said, I'll have to subdue you if you don't study.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali approaches to discipline, often used in family or rural settings.
